origin.source: FICTIONAL, NOT THE SITE: this repo is public, so the longitude here is deliberately wrong. The real origin comes from the environment at runtime (HEAR_SITE_ORIGIN='lat,lon,h_ell_m'; in the cluster Secret hear-site, key origin) and hear-tdoa refuses to run without it. The e/n/u below are relative to that real origin: median of nyquist; height datum is the --heights argument, NOT GNSS (storey = 3.0 m nominal US residential floor-to-floor, NOT measured)

nodes.name: rankine
nodes.u_source: same storey as mach, operator-stated; NOT measured

nodes.name: puc
nodes.u_source: PROVISIONAL -- not installed. e/n from the PUC's own GPS mean over 18 fixes (4-6 sats, HDOP 1.3-3.9), which scattered 6.5 m rms / 10.0 m max while stationary; u is a placeholder, NOT measured. Re-survey when sited.

nodes.name: gold
nodes.u_source: PROVISIONAL -- e/n from this node's own GPS mean (2-sigma fix, 3 sats, hacc_m 40.0). u set to datum floor, NOT measured. NOT CLAP-CALIBRATION GRADE: see docs/findings-clap-calibration-2026-09-14.md -- sigma_m this large (40 m) makes this position unusable as a calibration anchor; re-survey when sited/antenna improved.

nodes.name: ageev
nodes.u_source: PROVISIONAL -- e/n from this node's own GPS mean (weak fix, 3 sats, hacc_m 16.6). u set to datum floor, NOT measured. NOT CLAP-CALIBRATION GRADE: see docs/findings-clap-calibration-2026-09-14.md -- clock sync_sigma_ns also far over budget on this node; re-survey and re-check clock discipline before use.

nodes.name: kasami
nodes.u_source: PROVISIONAL -- e/n from this node's own GPS mean (weak fix, 2 sats, hacc_m 249.97 -- essentially unconstrained). u set to datum floor, NOT measured. NOT CLAP-CALIBRATION GRADE: see docs/findings-clap-calibration-2026-09-14.md; this position is not usable for any purpose until re-surveyed.
